rules.statement: An administrator appointed by the Court to administer the estate of a deceased person has power over every portion of his property within this Colony, and it endures for the life of the administrator or until the whole of the estate is administered.
rules.supporting_quote: "The rendering of a final account, much less an account that is not final in fact, does not make him functus officio, without a judicial settlement or a formal discharge or removal from office."
